rules.statement: Where the servient owner himself acts in a way which affects the exercise of the dominant owner's rights, and the dominant owner takes steps with a view to protecting himself against that conduct on the part of the servient owner and to secure the enjoyment of his servitude, and where no substantial damage has been caused from the protective steps so taken, the legal maxim de minimis non curat lex should be held to apply.
